bodyFinal:
Use case: precise-object-edit. EDIT Image1 garment only. Keep its established warm ivory/dusty slate-blue painted game style, moderate fold density, waist position, all canvas margins, native clarity, upper-body side perspective and motif.
CRITICAL CORRECTION: This is a CLOSED LONG ROBE in strict RIGHT-FACING SIDE VIEW. The user rejects the current irregular lower silhouette and false slit. Replace the whole skirt OUTER CONTOUR below the waist with a clean, flowing, continuous cloth shape like Image2's long-used closed robe.
Image2 is the approved old closed-robe construction reference, NOT a replacement canvas or size. Retain Image1's fullcanvas layout: waist sash center43.1%H, necktop9.2%, skirtbottom98.5%. Left edge is the BACK, right edge is FRONT. Keep only the visible side panel and narrow front binding on the RIGHT edge.
CLOTH SHAPE: From the back of the waist, the LEFT rear edge descends in ONE smooth long convex/very gently S-curved line. At the lower rear corner it turns softly into ONE clean shallow elliptical hem curve which joins the right front corner. Smooth tailored robe, uninterrupted outer edge: absolutely no repeated wavy bumps, no sawteeth, no scallops, no ruffles, no leaf-like notches, no missing bites. No petal hem. The finished lower perimeter is a simple graceful continuous curve. Cloth can bow gently backward as one sheet but must not be torn/cut into tongues.
CLOSE the current black narrow hole at bottom-right completely with ivory cloth. Remove the separate dangling right strip/tongue and unify it into the robe. NO SLIT of any kind (front/side/back), NO opening between two panels, NO transparent gap in the hem, NO hanging ribbons. Blue front edge is simply a narrow sewn binding which ends flush at the joined hem, not an open placket showing an inner black plane.
Inside this unified closed side panel, folds flow naturally from waist toward hem: 4-6 broad tapered soft graphite wash folds plus a few short waist gathers, comparable to our approved old Image2. Folds stay INSIDE the fabric, and do not cut the perimeter. Moderate credible texture, clear costume boundaries, not realistic microscopic weave, not featureless flat stripes.
Upper torso remains pure side view with narrow collar on front-right, no broad front-facing crossed collar. Keep small cloud motif and ivory/blue-gray identity. Real transparent alpha outside the robe, no background/halo/shadow, no head/arms/hands/legs/boots. Preserve all fullcanvas margins; don't crop/recenter.
